download.title: Put your knowledge back to work.
download.body: Choose your platform. Current builds are unsigned community test releases, so your operating system may show an unknown publisher warning.

items.a: NoNote is local-first. Original files stay in your file system. If you configure a cloud AI provider, relevant content is sent only when needed for the request. You can instead connect a compatible local provider.
The current release understands Markdown, TXT, PDF and DOCX. Original files are preserved; NoNote does not edit Word documents.

items.q: Can I use a local model?
items.a: Yes. NoNote can connect to compatible local providers such as Ollama. Model availability and performance depend on your hardware.

items.q: Is NoNote free and open source?
items.a: Yes. The source is available on GitHub under the MIT license.
Current release assets include macOS for Apple Silicon and Intel, plus Windows x64. Linux packaging is not part of this release.

items.q: How do I report an issue?
items.a: Open an issue in the GitHub repository and include your NoNote version, operating system and steps to reproduce.
